text: Your first review (8 Oct): four types seen (spikes in clusters, plateaus with walls and sometimes uncoloured tops, raised water, blocky "Minecraft" terraces), all worse at high zooms and shrinking with each lower zoom; examples near 12-961-1154, 11-240-558, 11-234-594, 12-464-1192, 12-152-1317, 10-288-97, 12-1249-1494. The study's agent is now finding each type's cause (sources, raw values, grids, water and glacier outlines), how common it is, and the fix it would recommend. Read-only; no repair changes.
